title: Few-example recall with a rule family handed to the learner
summary: A small pair memory reads K pairs and answers probes. Its learner is not searching blindly: it receives the family of rules the task belongs to, which contains the rule that answers a probe with the symbol written after the probe's earlier occurrence. With the family supplied, only an output translation is left to learn.
core_idea: Hand the learner the family that contains the target rule, so recall at small K is learned from a few dozen items.

state.name: W
state.meaning: Pair memory: C rows of (first symbol, second symbol); C = 64.

state.name: q
state.meaning: Left symbol waiting for its partner.

state.name: dep
state.meaning: Depth counter when the memory rows serve as a push-down list.

state.name: pos
state.meaning: Position counter after a separator, for string reproduction.

state.name: Rstar
state.meaning: The supplied rule family R*: here the single rule 'emit what followed the probe the last time it was seen', evaluated on the prefix.

state.name: T
state.meaning: Output translation learned from the items, V = 16 entries.

update.latex: q=\varnothing \Rightarrow q \leftarrow x_t;\;\text{else } W_c \leftarrow (q, x_t),\; c \leftarrow c+1
update.plain: pairs are written row by row
update.name: write

update.latex: \text{openers: } dep \leftarrow dep+1,\, W_{dep} \leftarrow (dep, x_t);\; \text{closers: } dep \leftarrow dep-1;\; \text{after separator: } pos \leftarrow pos+1
update.plain: bracket and string bookkeeping on the same rows
update.name: bookkeeping

readout.plain: rho is the supplied hypothesis applied to the prefix (the symbol after the probe's earlier occurrence); the output is T of rho; strings read W at pos and brackets read W at dep

learning.description: Given R*, learning fits T by majority count over the m training items (each probe gives one (rho, answer) pair). For strings and brackets the routing is chosen by training accuracy.
learning.few_shot_argument: R* contains the target rule, so the hypothesis space has one member and T only needs to see each of the V = 16 symbols: m = 32 items at K = 4 (128 probes) do.

complexity.constants_notes: Row writes are O(1); reads scan at most C rows. 2C + V + 4 words.

sample_efficiency.mechanism: The supplied family leaves only a translation table to learn.

prediction.statement: From m = 32 recall items with K = 4 pairs over V = 16, the learned rule answers with per-query accuracy at least 0.99 on three seeds.

capabilities.prediction: Learned at K = 4 from m = 32; the hand-set memory answers K = 8, 32, 64 exactly with C = 64.
Exact at T = 4, 16, 32 and hops 1, 4, 8 by repeated row reads.
The limit is a storage count: C slots of two words cannot hold more than C pairs, so at C = 64 an instance with 65 or more distinct pairs loses one of them.

known_relatives.name: not assessed
known_relatives.relation: This card does not compare its mechanism with others.
known_relatives.claimed_difference: No difference from earlier work is claimed.

falsifiers: 32 items at K = 4 after which recall accuracy is below 0.99 on some seed.
A recall instance with K <= 64 that the hand-set memory answers wrongly.

toy_example.description: The supplied rule applied to a K = 2 item.
